locked_by: this file and the commit that adds it; nothing below changes after any v2 label exists
rule: v2 rules were written after reading the round-1 pilot disagreements. The retest packet (pilot units) measures whether the repair works; only the confirm packet gives the agreement reported as the result. No rule, display or sample changes after any v2 agreement is computed.

labellers.claude: fresh Claude sub-agents given only item1a_guideline_v2.md and one packet; no earlier labels, no strata, no pilot results
labellers.external_llm: ChatGPT, new chat per packet, prompt_v2.md verbatim; model and version recorded per run

agreement: 5-class raw agreement and Cohen's kappa, plus material-vs-boilerplate kappa excluding ambiguous; computed on raw labels before any adjudication
claim: cross-model agreement (Claude vs an external LLM). Not independent human annotation.
